name: RCSI University of Medicine and Health Sciences
summary: Health-sciences university in Dublin with five school-leaver degrees: Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy and Advanced Therapeutics.

ib.text: 3 HL at 5 and 3 SL at 4, including English, Maths and a second language; most courses also a lab science. EU applicants apply through CAO and are ranked on IB points converted to CAO points.

programmes.name: Medicine
programmes.ib: HPAT-Ireland in your year of entry and at least 480 points. HL 5 in Chemistry and in Physics or Biology puts you on the five-year track; otherwise six years with a lab science.
programmes.about: Direct-entry medical degree in Dublin city centre, five or six years: clinical and communication skills from week one, cadaveric anatomy, simulation, then hospital rotations. Six-year entry adds a foundation year.

needs.note: English A: HL 3 or SL 4. English B: 4 (HL 4 or SL 6 if your IB is not in English).
Maths HL grade 4+ adds 25 bonus points.
Five-year track needs HL Chemistry 5 plus HL Physics or Biology.
A second language; 3 HL at 5 and 3 SL at 4 overall.

programmes.selectionNote: IB points converted to CAO points (min 480) plus HPAT-Ireland, sat in 2027; ranked on the total. 2027 changes the formula (HPAT to 150, points unmoderated).

programmes.name: Dentistry
programmes.ib: HL 5 in Chemistry and HL 5 in Biology or Physics, plus English, Maths and a second language.
programmes.about: Five-year Bachelor of Dental Surgery with supervised patient contact from Year 1, a simulated dental learning environment and community-based clinical teaching in RCSI's Dental Education Centres.

needs.note: English A: HL 3 or SL 4. English B: 4 (HL 4 or SL 6 if your IB is not in English).
Maths HL grade 4+ adds 25 bonus points.
A second language; 3 HL at 5 and 3 SL at 4 overall.

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on IB points converted to CAO points, highest first; a random draw settles ties at the cut-off.

programmes.name: Pharmacy
programmes.about: Five-year integrated programme awarding a BSc (Hons) and an MPharm, with clinical skills from Year 1, prescribing built into the curriculum and teaching alongside future doctors and dentists.

needs.note: English A: HL 3 or SL 4. English B: 4 (HL 4 or SL 6 if your IB is not in English).
Maths HL grade 4+ adds 25 bonus points.
A second language; 3 HL at 5 and 3 SL at 4 overall.

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on IB points converted to CAO points, highest first; a random draw settles ties at the cut-off.

programmes.name: Physiotherapy
programmes.about: Four-year BSc combining lectures, practical workshops and clinical simulation with over 1,000 hours of placement in hospitals and rehabilitation settings; you study alongside future doctors, dentists and pharmacists.

needs.note: English A: HL 3 or SL 4. English B: 4 (HL 4 or SL 6 if your IB is not in English).
Maths HL grade 4+ adds 25 bonus points.
A second language; 3 HL at 5 and 3 SL at 4 overall.

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on IB points converted to CAO points, highest first; a random draw settles ties at the cut-off.

programmes.name: Advanced Therapeutic Technologies
programmes.ib: HL Maths 5; a lab science is not required in the IB version of the rule.
programmes.about: Four-year science degree designed with biopharma companies: the drug lifecycle, advanced therapeutics, AI and data analytics, lab practicals and an eight-month work placement.

needs.note: English A: HL 3 or SL 4. English B: 4 (HL 4 or SL 6 if your IB is not in English).
Maths HL grade 4+ adds 25 bonus points.
A second language; 3 HL at 5 and 3 SL at 4 overall.

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on IB points converted to CAO points, highest first; a random draw settles ties at the cut-off.

notes: EU places are limited and filled strictly by points: Medicine has 90 EU places (220 non-EU), Dentistry 35.
From 2027 Medicine counts HPAT for at most 150 points, down from 300, and no longer moderates school scores above 550.
Pharmacy is a five-year integrated BSc and MPharm; year 5 has an eight-month patient-facing placement and ends with the Professional Registration Examination.
